en.title: Chrome Rain and the Ghost's Testament
en.premise: In a night where ceaseless acid rain blurs the city's neon glow, I live as a back-alley hacker, scavenging through the dumping grounds of information. One day, a dying android entrusts me with a "testament." It is the location of a bar that shouldn't exist—a place that opens only when it rains. But as I delve deeper into the data, the abyss of corporate conspiracies and erased memories come rushing in like a torrential flood.

zh.title: 铬之雨与亡灵的遗言
zh.premise: 酸雨连绵不绝，模糊了城市的霓虹。我是一个在小巷中徘徊的黑客，游走于信息的垃圾场。直到有一天，我从一个濒死的仿生人那里接到了“遗言”。那是一个本不该存在的酒吧地址，只在雨天才会营业。随着解析的深入，企业的深渊与本该被抹除的记忆，如浊流般奔涌而至。
